title: Nac's Lime Copper Lights (LITE)
description: Copper Lanterns & Torches will have a Nice lime green Color!
body:
# A Nicer Green!
Inspired on what's seen on the snapshots.

The textures of copper torches & lanterns will be a **vibrant lime-green** color!

instead of the vanilla's sad, _pale green_.

![A comparison of the copper lanterns, torch's vanilla textures vs my textures. Making the green light coming out of these to be more bright lime.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5e9549ab9ae89ba580eb1488186749c79e3a0fb.gif)

<details>
<summary>List of changed textures</summary>

- Copper Torch
- Copper Lanterns (in all oxidation stages)
- Copper Fire Flame Particle
</details>

## Full version!
Also changing the Bulb & Copper golem's Eyes to match the other copper lights! so it's all consistent and beautiful!

Perfect for those who prefer consistency between textures
[Click to see Full Version!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lime-copper-lights)

<details>
<summary>Terms of Use</summary>

If you want to use my pack in another resource pack, make sure to credit me,
This also applies if you just modify the same pack, i will ask for credit.

You are free to use my pack personally and include it in videos without issue.
